record.issue_text: app/models/topic_embed.rb:37 — Advancing content_sha1 without checking revise! success permanently marks callback-rejected post updates as imported

adjudication.rationale: Looking at app/models/topic_embed.rb lines 30-37, when updating an existing embed, the code calls `revisor.revise!()` and then unconditionally calls `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` regardless of whether revise! succeeded. If revise! fails (returns false due to callbacks or other issues), the content_sha1 is still updated, which means future attempts to update the same content will be skipped (since content_sha1 matches) even though the actual post content was never updated. This is a real bug where the state tracking gets out of sync with actual data.
